examples.ar: الْكِتَابُ خَيْرُ جَلِيسٍ فِي الزَّمَانِ لِمَنْ يَبْحَثُ عَنِ الحِكْمَةِ.
examples.en: The book is the best companion in time for whoever seeks wisdom.

examples.ar: ذَٰلِكَ الْكِتَابُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ.
examples.en: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of God.

examples.ar: خَيْرُ الكَلَامِ مَا قَلَّ وَدَلَّ وَلَمْ يُطِلْ فَيُمِلَّ.
examples.en: The best speech is that which is brief, clear, and not long-winded to cause boredom.

examples.ar: يَشْتَهِرُ أَهْلُ الشَّرْقِ بِالكَرَمِ وَحُسْنِ الضِّيَافَةِ.
examples.en: People of the East are famous for generosity and good hospitality.

examples.ar: الْتَّطَوُّرُ المُسْتَمِرُّ هُوَ سَعْيٌ دَائِمٌ نَحْوَ الكَمَالِ.
examples.en: Continuous development is a permanent pursuit of perfection.

examples.ar: الْتَّأَمُّلُ فِي بَدِيعِ صُنْعِ الكَوْنِ يَزِيدُ الإِيمَانَ.
examples.en: Contemplating the wonderful design of the universe increases faith.

examples.ar: نَالَتِ الشُّعُوبُ حُرِّيَّتَهَا بَعْدَ كِفَاحٍ مَرِيرٍ.
examples.en: Nations achieved their freedom after a bitter struggle.
And beneath it was a treasure for them.
